verdict.rationale: BigCommerce exposes REST and GraphQL APIs that can be used to pull products, orders, customers, and settings programmatically (bigcommerce-docs-30, bigcommerce-docs-25), which gives a technical path to extract data in open JSON formats, but there is no documented bulk 'export all my data' feature, data-portability guarantee, or migration-out tooling. missing for 10: explicit full-account data export/download feature, documented data portability/GDPR-style export policy, and evidence of successful full data migration away from BigCommerce.
